source_pins.name: Anthropic Effective Context Engineering for AI Agents
source_pins.observed: Context is finite; context engineering optimizes utility of tokens rather than maximizing raw history.

source_pins.name: Anthropic Compaction
source_pins.observed: Server-side compaction summarizes older context as windows grow; useful as evidence that long active contexts degrade, but summarization is lossy/provider-specific.

source_pins.name: OpenAI Prompt Caching
source_pins.observed: Exact rendered-prefix reuse stores/reuses KV states, reduces repeated prefill work and latency, but does not remove tokens from the logical context and cached input tokens still count toward rate limits.

source_pins.name: vLLM Automatic Prefix Caching
source_pins.observed: Hash-bound full-block KV reuse; supports deterministic/cross-language hash serialization and cache salts. The mechanism is output-neutral compute reuse, not semantic context reduction.

source_pins.name: LongLLMLingua
source_pins.observed: Upstream reports 2x-6x prompt compression with 1.4x-2.6x end-to-end latency acceleration on about-10k-token prompts and task-specific quality gains; these are upstream claims only, not F2 evidence.

source_pins.name: LLMLingua-2
source_pins.observed: Uses token classification / extractive compression to improve faithfulness and reports 1.6x-2.9x end-to-end speedups at 2x-5x compression; still requires a learned compressor model.

source_pins.name: Microsoft LLMLingua
source_pins.observed: Central compressor source is about 110 kB and package dependencies include transformers, accelerate, torch, tiktoken, nltk and numpy. Direct import is materially heavier than a native deterministic selector.

source_pins.name: LangChain SummarizationMiddleware
source_pins.observed: Summarization is threshold-driven, uses a separate model call, keeps a recent tail and replaces older history with generated summary state. Useful pattern for trigger/keep budgets, unsafe as canonical F2 evidence without provenance and loss accounting.

source_pins.name: Lost in the Middle
source_pins.observed: Long-context models can use evidence non-uniformly by position; larger context is not automatically better context.

source_pins.name: SCBench
source_pins.observed: Evaluates generation/compression/retrieval/loading across shared-context workloads; warns that long-context/KV optimizations are workload-sensitive and that aggressive sub-O(n) memory methods can degrade multi-turn robustness.

source_pins.name: LMCache
source_pins.observed: Persistent/tiered KV reuse can reduce repeated prefill cost but introduces a serving/cache layer and is orthogonal to semantic evidence selection. Treat as later runtime optimization, not WP306 canonical context authority.

findings.claim: WP306 must distinguish semantic context selection from inference-cache reuse.
findings.falsifier: A candidate demonstrates that its cache layer changes the selected evidence set while preserving exact F2 provenance; no current source supports that.

findings.claim: The lowest-risk first implementation is a deterministic typed selector with explicit budgets, stable ordering and provenance-preserving omission receipts.
findings.falsifier: An external framework wins an F2-equivalent ablation on tokens/latency/quality/provenance with lower complexity and no second state authority.

findings.claim: Lossy summarization/compression must be downstream and optional, never allowed to overwrite canonical evidence or hide omitted source identities.
findings.falsifier: A formally lossless compressor with exact invertibility and provenance coverage is demonstrated at F2 scope.

findings.claim: Direct LLMLingua import is not justified at E1 because its model/dependency footprint is large relative to the native WP306 baseline hypothesis.
findings.falsifier: F2 E4 ablation shows a net quality/resource win that exceeds dependency/resident-model overhead.

proposed_layers: L0 canonical evidence remains in UnifiedDB/current F2 canonical substrate
L1 deterministic candidate retrieval/filtering by type, provenance, generation, causal relevance and policy
L2 deterministic budget allocator with stable token/byte/item caps and priority tiers
L3 ContextView manifest containing included source identities plus explicit omitted/deferred identities and reason codes
L4 optional extractive/lossy compressor only for non-authoritative payload text, never identity/provenance fields
L5 provider/runtime prefix-KV cache adapter outside semantic selection

required_e2_questions: What exact ContextView schema preserves included/omitted evidence identity and generation?
What deterministic ranking function can be evaluated without model self-scoring becoming authority?
Which payload classes may be compressed and which must remain byte/exact-identity preserved?
How should static prompt/tool/schema prefixes be separated from volatile evidence to maximize cache hits without corrupting semantics?
What ablation fixture proves token reduction does not remove the decisive negative/contradictory evidence item?
